text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High CUDA OOM rate detected on streaming decode cluster (rt-decode). Error signature: cudaErrorIllegalAddress + container restart loops. Auto-quarantine engaged for 3 nodes. Root ts: 1887654321

alice_sre: I'm on it. Seeing 5xx spikes and node flaps in eu-west-1. Observability dashboard shows memory creeping before crash.

ben_prodops: Copy. Which pool? I see stream-proxy -> rt-decode pods on g4-rt-1.

carla_ml: Repro steps from logs: runaway generation + header maxtokens mismatch in ~req-id: req_7a2bf. Some clients sending huge max_tokens=1e6 via old SDK.

dan_engineer: Ugh. That explains KV cache growth. Can we short-circuit long outputs? Temporary mitigation: enforce server-side max_tokens=2048 for streaming route.

alice_sre: Applying ipre-waf header override now: set X-Override-Max-Tokens=2048 at edge for /v1/stream. Pushing as emergency config (non-disruptive).

ben_prodops: Also adding a token throttling policy to the proxy to drop requests exceeding 2048 tokens with 429 + retry-after 30s.

carla_ml: Good. Also identify long-lived KV caches. Running query:

```
kubectl -n prod exec -it svc/rt-metrics -- sh -c "ps aux | grep rt-decode && jcmd $(pgrep rt-decode) GC.heap_info"
```

Records show some decoders holding 12GB of KV per session.


frank_oncall: I isolated 3 pods in Quarantine group. Restarting affected pods one-by-one to clear state. Rolling restart command:

```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/rt-decode --selector=quarantine=true
```

Restarted pod rt-decode-7f9, crash loop stopped on that host.


eva_support: Customer ops: CS reported increased 5xx on chat flows. Ticket INC-8921 created; affected customers: beta.ai, docs-gen. Notifying account teams.

carla_ml: Short-term model fallback: set route config to use quantized-small (q4) variant for streaming when node memory > 80% to reduce KV footprint.

alice_sre: Implemented fallback rule in router. Also added real-time alert to page if >2 nodes in quarantine for >5m.

ben_prodops: Patching runtime to reject obvious maxtokens header abuse. Uploaded hotpatch to edge:

```
if request.headers.get('max_tokens',0) > 50000:
  raise Reject(400, 'max_tokens too large')
```

Deployed canary to 3 edge hosts.


dan_engineer: Noticed a bunch of legacy SDKs not honoring token caps. We should add telemetry to show client-sent max_tokens vs server-enforced.

frank_oncall: Customer impact summary for CS: ~0.9% request loss for streaming routes over last 12m, main impact between 10:02-10:20 UTC. Sent initial blurb to account teams.

eva_support: Copy. Drafting status update:
- What happened: runaway generations from badly configured clients led to GPU memory growth and OOMs, causing pod restarts and request drops.
- Mitigation: server-side token cap + throttling, quarantined nodes, model fallback, pod restarts.
- Next steps: postmortem, SDK patch, telemetry, and permanent router guards.

alice_sre: Handoff to night oncall @frank_oncall in 25m. Leaving watch on alerts and rollback plan:
- rollback caps (edge) if >10% 502s within 5m
- revert fallback only after telemetry shows stable memory patterns for 30m

carla_ml: We'll run prompt sets against q4 variant to validate quality for affected flows. If regression >5% we escalate for targeted customer rollbacks.

ben_prodops: Added follow-up tasks in INC ticket: (1) add server limit to api-gateway, (2) SDK release note, (3) autoscale policy to spin up warm decoders under token surge.

frank_oncall: I'll keep a 1hr shadow. If I see >3 OOMs in 10m I'll trigger full capacity shift to Dedicated pool. Filing oncall note.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation checklist updated. Current state: throttles in place, 3 nodes quarantined, model fallback active, customer comms in progress. Monitoring for 30m.

alice_sre: Quick logs for triage (snip):
```
[rt-decode][error] cudaErrorIllegalAddress at decode_kernel.cu:421
[rt-decode][warn] token_loop exceeded expected len: 450k
[container] restartCount=4
```

carla_ml: saved full traces to s3://redwood-incident-archive/1887654321/ for postmortem.

eva_support: Posted initial CS status to customers. Will update after 30m if stable. :thumbsup:

frank_oncall: Acknowledged handoff. Leaving Slack watch channel open. Will notify if anything flares.
